'''Scott Lingrell''' ([[GEMP]] handle '''advocate'''; also '''crngwell''')<ref name="yt">[https://www.youtube.com/@crngwell @crngwell] on YouTube. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260927195243/https://www.youtube.com/@crngwell Wayback 27 September 2026]</ref> is the current Lead Advocate of the [[Players Committee]]. He was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] (Rogue 60).<ref name="slack-lingrell-2026">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Scott Lingrell, 9 October 2026. "Also, it's not complete. I was gold 60 I think. Rogue 60 sorry"</ref>
